orientation_hints.nspect_context: NSPECT-S57Q-EI19 is the nSpect registration used for nvis-rack-status. This profile covers the nvis-rack-status repository only.
orientation_hints.revision_note: repo.revision is the main-branch snapshot this profile was aligned to, not a live always-HEAD pointer. repo.branch is the canonical product branch (main); the reconstruction work was authored on feat/agentic-plc-security.
orientation_hints.scope_note: Security reconstruction (local advisory SAST, dependency CVE, license and Pulse secret scans plus a SecNemo Agent-TAVA threat model) was followed on 2026-08-24 by reconstruction of the SRD, SADD and SUTP, which are now drafts under .plc/ rather than missing. They are snapshots for grooming, not ratified PLC documents.
orientation_hints.product_boundary: Standalone product. Rack Status is a complete solution deployed at customer clusters so NVIS and partners can bring up NVIDIA clusters; NSPECT-S57Q-EI19 registers it as such, and the SRD/SADD/SUTP are product-level documents. Author decision, 2026-08-24.
orientation_hints.development_model: Collaborative and SA-driven. Periodic releases; NVIS Solutions Architects contribute by merge request; explicitly not a one-way door. No formal supported-version window or customer SLA.
integration_points: SSH to cluster head node and compute trays (host_exec / transport)
open_questions: Should the two sibling deployments (nvis-mel01 worktree: Firmus MEL01, Boston BOS01) be covered by this same registration or their own?

Whether to commit performance SLAs (page load, fleet-scan duration at 2000+ nodes, acceptable staleness of live state). None exist today beyond the audit path's 5 ms p95 budget, and none are planned yet.
